item.title: dotnet: Routing and Failover for Microsoft.Extensions.AI
item.description:
Microsoft.Extensions.AI adds experimental routing primitives for model/provider selection and failover: RoutingChatClient, SemanticRoutingChatClient, and FailoverChatClient. These support content-based routing, failover handling, and custom routing policies.

  • Source: .NET

item.title: dotnet: Instructions Hygiene – What Frontier Models Still Need You to Say
item.description:
The post says frontier models still need explicit, well-scoped instructions to work reliably. It emphasizes giving the right level of guidance rather than assuming the model will infer missing details.

  • Source: .NET

item.title: dotnet: Test reporting in Microsoft.Testing.Platform: from red build to root cause
item.description:
Microsoft.Testing.Platform adds test reporting that surfaces failures in GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps, uses pipeline history to distinguish regressions from flaky tests, and keeps reports usable even if the test host crashes.

item.title: dotnet: Beyond Chat: live Speech-to-Text with Foundry Local and C#
item.description:
The post shows how to build a live speech-to-text app in C# using Foundry Local and a compact Nemotron model. It also covers local model lifecycle management.

  • Source: .NET

item.title: dotnet: Strengthening NuGet Supply Chain Security: Reducing API Key Lifetime
item.description:
NuGet API key lifetimes will be reduced to 30 days starting August 17, with the goal of improving supply chain security.

  • Source: .NET

item.title: dotnet: From generated code to trusted code with a unit-test agent
item.description:
Microsoft introduced an open-source polyglot unit-testing agent that analyzes a repository, generates unit tests, and verifies that the tests build and pass. The post focuses on moving from generated code to code that is checked and trusted through automated testing.

  • Source: .NET

item.title: dotnet: Announcing v2.0 of the official MCP C# SDK
item.description:
The official MCP C# SDK v2.0 now implements the 2026-07-28 MCP specification. It adds a stateless-first protocol, standardized HTTP headers, and Multi Round-Trip Requests for interactive tools while remaining backward compatible.

  • Source: .NET

item.title: dotnet: Analyze MSBuild Binary Logs with Copilot in VS Code
item.description:
Microsoft introduced the MSBuild Binlog Analyzer for VS Code, a Copilot-powered tool for reading MSBuild binary logs, explaining build failures, suggesting fixes, comparing builds, and identifying regressions. It uses the Microsoft.AITools.BinlogMcp MCP server.

  • Source: .NET

item.title: dotnet: Announcing .NET Modernization for Beginners
item.description:
Microsoft announced a free, open-source hands-on course for modernizing a legacy ASP.NET application to .NET 10 using the GitHub Copilot modernization agent. The course is step-by-step and aimed at beginners.
